explanations.en: The policy requires 24 months for hernia. Covered 14 months with this insurer.

findings.fix: Do NOT file this as a payable claim now. Ask your insurer/TPA in writing: 'Please confirm if any prior continuous health cover can be credited to my 24-month hernia wait?' If you had NO prior policy without break, self-pay and wait - hernia cover opens only after 01-08-2027. If you DID have a prior policy, get a Portability Certificate from the old insurer showing continuous dates and sum insured and attach it before submission.
